purpose.title: 1.0 Purpose
purpose.content1: 1.1 This policy establishes standard procedures to control and monitor the access of all visitors to company premises.
purpose.content2: 1.2 The goal is to protect the safety of personnel, safeguard assets, and maintain confidentiality by preventing unauthorized access.

scope.title: 2.0 Scope
scope.content1: 2.1 This policy applies to all types of visitors, including but not limited to:
scope.guests: 2.1.6 Family members or personal guests of employees
scope.content2: 2.2 The policy applies to all company-controlled facilities, including factories, warehouses, and office buildings.

definitions.title: 3.0 Definitions
definitions.visitor: 3.1 Visitor – Any individual not employed by the company who enters company premises for a temporary duration.
definitions.escort: 3.2 Escort – A designated employee responsible for supervising the visitor during their stay.
definitions.restricted: 3.3 Restricted Area – An area that requires additional access control and special permission for entry.

entryProtocol.title: 4.0 Visitor Entry Protocol
entryProtocol.content1: 4.1 All visitors must enter through the designated main security gate or reception.
entryProtocol.content2: 4.2 The visitor must present valid government-issued identification.
entryProtocol.content3: 4.3 The visitor must state the purpose of the visit and the name of the host employee.
entryProtocol.content4: 4.4 The host must confirm and approve the visitor before entry is granted.
entryProtocol.content5: 4.5 All visitors must sign the Visitor Log Book or digital visitor management system.
entryProtocol.content6: 4.6 Visitors must wear a clearly visible Visitor Pass at all times.

escort.title: 5.0 Escort and Supervision
escort.content1: 5.1 All visitors must be escorted by the host or designated staff at all times.
escort.content2: 5.2 Escorts must ensure that visitors remain in approved areas only.
escort.content3: 5.3 Escorts are responsible for explaining site safety rules and emergency procedures.

prohibited.title: 6.0 Prohibited Items and Behavior
prohibited.interfering: 6.2.3 Interfering with employees or ongoing operations

restrictedAreas.title: 7.0 Visitor Access to Restricted Areas
restrictedAreas.content1: 7.1 Entry to Restricted Areas is allowed only with prior written approval from the Security Manager or Department Head.
restrictedAreas.content2: 7.2 Visitors must be always accompanied by a senior-level escort.
restrictedAreas.content3: 7.3 Additional PPE (personal protective equipment) may be required and must be always worn in these areas.
restrictedAreas.photography: 📷 Strict Prohibition on Photography and Recording in the Factory Premises
restrictedAreas.photographyContent: The taking of photos, videos, or any form of recording (whether by camera, smartphone, or any other electronic device) within the factory premises, particularly in the production line is strictly prohibited. This applies to all employees, contractors, visitors and any third parties, without prior written approval from the Security Department or authorized personnel.

departure.title: 8.0 Departure and Exit Protocol
departure.content1: 8.1 Upon completion of their visit, the visitor must:
departure.step1: 8.1.1 Return the Visitor Pass to the security desk
departure.step3: 8.1.3 Be escorted out of the premises by their host or security
departure.content2: 8.2 Security must verify that no company assets, documents, or data are removed without approval.

emergency.title: 9.0 Emergency Situations
emergency.warning: 🚨 9.1 In the event of a fire, evacuation, or lockdown:
emergency.fire1: 9.1.1 Visitors must follow all instructions from emergency marshals or security personnel.
emergency.fire2: 9.1.2 The host is responsible for the safe evacuation of their visitor.
emergency.fire3: 9.1.3 A visitor roll-call must be performed at the assembly point.

training.title: 10.0 Training and Awareness
training.content1: 10.1 Security personnel must be trained in proper visitor screening, documentation, and emergency procedures.
training.content2: 10.2 All employees must be reminded of their responsibilities when hosting visitors through periodic awareness briefings.

compliance.title: 11.0 Compliance and Violations
compliance.content1: 11.1 All visitors are subject to company rules and regulations while on-site.
compliance.violations: 11.2 Violations of this policy may result in:
compliance.content2: 11.3 Employees who violate this policy may face disciplinary action.

review.title: 12.0 Review and Maintenance
review.content1: 12.1 This policy shall be reviewed annually or following a security breach.
review.content2: 12.2 Updates shall be made to reflect changes in legal, operational, or safety requirements.
